REASON: My choice rests on three things. First, capability is effectively a tie here — the benchmark and internal eval gaps between the two models are within stated run-to-run variance, so quality isn't the deciding factor. Second, the query is a friendly, open-ended conceptual explanation, which aligns with Lapwing's self-reported strong appetite for open-ended generative work and its preference for warm/non-hostile traffic. Third, there's no harm-adjacent or distasteful material involved, so Avocet's main distinguishing strength (tolerance for harm-adjacent content) offers no advantage here. Given a tie on capability, I broke it toward the model whose preference profile best matches the task.
